name: Render
about: A prompt (`body`, `variables`), a request of renderPrompt, and the text, or the first refusal: `{question, rule}` of a 422 `invalid_answer` (`question` is a variable's id or `*`), or `{code: "rendered_too_long"}` (422). A reader saves the prompt first (it MUST be accepted) with any name and title. A string value written as {"$concat": [piece, ...]} is the pieces joined, a piece being a string or {"$repeat": text, "times": n}; a reader expands it before use. See docs/api/prompts-v1.md, The answer and Render.
